core_question: How do I waterproof a leather jacket before wearing it in the rain? (secondary: How do I apply rosin to a violin bow?)
answer_summary: Clean the jacket, then apply an even, light coat of a leather-safe waterproofing spray over the entire surface, letting it dry fully before wearing.; after the topic shift: Hold the bow hair taut and draw the rosin cake back and forth along its full length several times so a fine layer coats the hair, which lets it grip the strings.
